summary_zh:
從史科嘉瀑布，旁邊的步道走上，當你走上步到起，步行 20-30 分鐘左右， 你會接連看到 3 個小瀑布，蠻值得一來的。

在這上面，步行 20 分鐘內，你會看到三個瀑布 - 馬渡瀑布、福斯托爾瀑布、石拱瀑布，如果你旅行時間較為彈性，我蠻推薦走上來看看的，你會發現史科嘉瀑布上游是這景觀。
summary_en: From the Skógar waterfall, follow the trail beside it; after about a 20‑30 minute walk you’ll encounter three small waterfalls, making it well worth a visit. Within a 20‑minute walk you’ll see three waterfalls—Maðavörfoss, Fossar Þóris, and Stone Arch waterfall. If you have flexible travel time, I highly recommend walking up to see them, as you’ll discover that the upstream area of Skógar waterfall features this scenery.
